reference.citation: Median absolute deviation (Hampel 1974). Reference impls: scipy.stats.median_abs_deviation (Virtanen et al.) and base R stats::mad. Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the median absolute deviation with scipy.stats.median_abs_deviation and base R mad (both scale/constant = 1) and confirms medianAbsDev reproduces BOTH bit-for-bit; also reports the normal-consistent robust SD estimate, the population SD, their ratio, and the sample count
